summary: Moleculin Biotech filed an 8-K reporting a Mexican patent grant (No. 436849) covering its lung-targeted liposomal Annamycin technology, plus September 2026 at-the-market sales of 888,400 shares for $0.48 million gross, leaving 20,385,780 shares outstanding. Anti-dilution provisions in the August 3, 2026 Series I Warrants (37,130,001 shares, originally $0.75) reset the exercise price to $0.51. These are routine disclosure and capital-raising mechanics—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic event. Watch continued ATM dilution and warrant overhang pressuring the share price.
